decision: Correct the candidate record: BRENTOIL has exact live-canary, liquidity, development, source-parity, and prospective observer evidence. Retain the asset as the highest-priority external non-crypto investigation, keep both retired BRENTOIL routes rejected, and collect the new oil-shock mechanism prospectively without execution authority.

problem_restatement.observed_gap: The exact BRENTOIL evidence existed but was absent from the active v51 live-route improvement digest because BRENTOIL is not an active v51 route.
problem_restatement.required_outcome: Maintain a separately identified external-candidate pipeline so non-roster evidence is visible without corrupting the exact active-route scope.
success_criteria: live-canary lifecycle counts and economics reconcile
current liquidity and prospective observer status are visible
development stress failure and technical blockers remain explicit
the pipeline cannot route orders or authorize promotion

hypothesis_ledger.hypothesis: A new oil-shock reversion mechanism may exploit a liquid BRENTOIL lane after live-derived friction even though the retired Swing and breakout-pressure routes failed.
hypothesis_ledger.update_condition: At least one fully resolved prospective lifecycle per direction plus predeclared validation with resolved candle and mark/L2 paths.
hypothesis_ledger.rejection_condition: Resolved stress and validation economics remain nonpositive, source parity remains unresolved, or execution costs erase the candidate edge.

hypothesis_ledger.hypothesis: The retired Swing or breakout-pressure identities establish BRENTOIL edge.
hypothesis_ledger.new_evidence_required_to_reopen: A materially different source, mechanism, or market-regime hypothesis with predeclared validation; the three historical live closes alone are insufficient.

change_proposal.Recommendation: Continue the BRENTOIL oil-shock observer and external-candidate monitor; do not restore the retired routes or add live authority.
change_proposal.Why now: The asset satisfies the user's liquidity requirement and has real execution history, but the evidence was not represented in the active research frontier.
Evidence reviewed: development-only oil-shock replay with nominal and stress friction
change_proposal.Observed problem or opportunity: BRENTOIL is liquid and executable, while its retired mechanisms failed and its new mechanism remains technically and economically unvalidated.
change_proposal.Applicable market regime: Five-minute oil-shock and short-horizon mean-reversion conditions; current observer requires a causal eligible onset.
Alternatives considered: discard BRENTOIL because retired routes failed
restore a retired route from three mixed-policy live closes
continue a distinct report-only mechanism with exact live-derived friction
change_proposal.Expected upside: Preserves a top-ten liquid diversification lane and gathers mechanism-specific evidence without risking portfolio capital.
Main risks and failure modes: nominal development performance disappears under stress
three historical closes create false confidence
largest-winner concentration overstates prior live performance
Validation completed: point-in-time liquidity rank and spread measured
development-only nominal and stress replay completed
report-only observer and monitor contracts tested
Validation still required: resolve candleSnapshot versus archive trade-OHLC parity
resolve historical and prospective mark/L2 paths
observe eligible long and short lifecycles
run predeclared validation and untouched holdout only after technical resolution
compare against v51 baseline and no-action at portfolio level
Success metrics: source and lifecycle paths technically resolved
stress net and profit factor remain positive without the largest winner
both directions contribute under the predeclared test
realized friction remains within the declared live-derived envelope
Failure / rollback triggers: observer identity or authority contract changes
one side or one winner determines the result
change_proposal.Confidence level: High confidence that BRENTOIL has usable asset and execution data; low confidence that the new mechanism has an edge.

uncertainties_and_falsifiers: A later exact reconciliation that changes the three lifecycle outcomes updates the descriptive live assessment.
A representative liquidity window outside the top ten or with materially worse spread/depth updates asset viability.
Resolved prospective and out-of-sample evidence may accept or reject the new mechanism.
Any order, signer, automatic promotion, or live configuration surface in this pipeline invalidates the implementation.
